title: Alles KOKUEN v5 stable component contracts

contracts.user_job: Invoke one immediate or asynchronous operation.
contracts.boundary_rationale: A boundary is present only when the action needs separation or destructive emphasis; quiet actions use tone and spacing.
contracts.width_behavior: Fits its label, wraps only in narrow action groups, and never stretches without a form or toolbar reason.
contracts.pointer_touch: One activation per pointer or touch release; the target does not move on hover.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Disabled is non-activating; busy disables repeat activation and exposes aria-busy with an active verb.
content_constraints: Use a direct verb
Do not use icon-only destructive actions without a name

contracts.user_job: Invoke a compact local tool without sacrificing target size.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The mark is bare at rest; hover and selection use one tonal silhouette rather than an icon tile plus border.
contracts.width_behavior: Fixed square target; the glyph remains optically centered at every density.
contracts.pointer_touch: The full square activates once and never translates or scales.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Disabled and busy retain the target while rejecting activation.

accessibility.name: Required aria-label
accessibility.focus: One ring around the full square

content_constraints: Use a product-owned mark
No tooltip-only naming

contracts.user_job: Enter or edit one bounded value.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The input affordance owns one resting edge; wrappers do not add a second rectangle.
contracts.width_behavior: Width follows expected content; only search, command, composition, and full-row data entry stretch.
contracts.pointer_touch: Clicking the label or field focuses the native input; end actions own separate 44px targets.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Read-only, disabled, busy, and unavailable remain distinct and retain their current value.

accessibility.name: Persistent label
accessibility.focus: One ring or boundary shift around the input region

content_constraints: Keep recovery copy adjacent
Do not rely on placeholder as the label

contracts.boundary_rationale: The track is the sole boundary and its whole silhouette communicates on or off.
contracts.width_behavior: The track stays fixed while its text column wraps independently.
contracts.pointer_touch: The complete row or named 44px control toggles once.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Busy and disabled reject repeat toggles and preserve aria-checked.

accessibility.name: Persistent setting label
accessibility.focus: One ring around the 44px switch target

content_constraints: Use for immediate binary changes
Do not use for choosing among three or more values

contracts.user_job: Choose one value from a bounded custom list.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The trigger owns one field boundary and the open listbox owns one containment edge.
contracts.width_behavior: Trigger width follows its field; the listbox is at least trigger width and stays inside the viewport.
contracts.pointer_touch: Trigger opens; one option click selects, emits change, closes, and restores trigger focus.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Disabled cannot open; loading and empty remain announced inside the same surface.

accessibility.name: aria-label or labelled field
accessibility.focus: DOM focus remains on the trigger

keyboard.exit: Escape closes and Tab closes while continuing

content_constraints: Options must have unique values
Long labels wrap or truncate without hiding selection

contracts.user_job: Move among peer sections without leaving the current app.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The shared navigation region is structural; selected state is tonal and typographic rather than a decorative underline.
contracts.width_behavior: Tabs wrap only when designed as a rail; narrow horizontal sets scroll without clipping focus.
contracts.pointer_touch: Selecting a tab updates one panel and URL-compatible state.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Disabled tabs leave the current selection unchanged.

accessibility.name: Tablist label and visible tab labels

content_constraints: Use short peer labels
Do not use tabs for global apps

contracts.user_job: Choose one contextual action from a temporary set.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The temporary action set owns one containment edge; items add no resting boxes.
contracts.width_behavior: Fits the longest expected label up to the viewport and wraps recovery copy.
contracts.pointer_touch: Trigger toggles; choosing an item closes unless the documented multi-select job requires otherwise.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Disabled items remain perceivable and do not activate.

accessibility.name: Trigger name and menu label
accessibility.focus: Focus moves into the menu and returns to the trigger

content_constraints: Use verbs for actions
Do not use as persistent navigation

contracts.user_job: Complete an interruptive bounded task without losing place.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The modal surface owns one containment edge; nested fields keep only their input boundaries.
contracts.width_behavior: Uses the narrowest width that fits the task and never exceeds the viewport at 200 percent zoom.
contracts.pointer_touch: Explicit actions close according to policy; destructive confirmation never fires from scrim click.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Busy keeps the dialog open, disables repeat submission, and reports progress in place.

accessibility.name: aria-labelledby
accessibility.focus: Trapped inside while open, never clipped

keyboard.entry: Programmatic focus to first task control or safe action

content_constraints: State consequence before confirmation
Keep recovery inside the same surface

contracts.user_job: Expose global navigation or a secondary work surface while preserving context.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The sheet edge separates the temporary global layer from the preserved app surface; rows have no card borders.
contracts.width_behavior: 420px maximum on desktop and the viewport remainder beside the 52px shell rail on narrow screens.
contracts.pointer_touch: Trigger toggles; close and scrim dismiss; destination activation preserves the cover during cross-origin handoff.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Navigation remains available while app content is stale or offline; unavailable destinations report honestly.

accessibility.name: Visible sheet heading
accessibility.focus: Trapped in the sheet; app content is inert

content_constraints: Primary spaces precede exactly nine specialist apps
Settings is a utility, not a tenth app

contracts.user_job: Find data, move to a shipped surface, or hand a bounded query to Aide or Andromeda.
contracts.boundary_rationale: The dialog and input region each have one distinct job; rows use selection tone without nested card edges.
contracts.width_behavior: 640px maximum, full available width on phone, and bounded height with internal list scrolling.
contracts.pointer_touch: Query input filters; one result activation closes and performs its documented route or handoff.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Async requests are sequenced; stale responses cannot replace current results.

accessibility.name: Universal command
accessibility.focus: Input retains focus; dialog traps Tab

content_constraints: Keep action labels explicit
Expose unavailable and permission states without dead rows

contracts.user_job: Scan, select, filter, and act on application records.
contracts.boundary_rationale: Rows rely on alignment and state tone; structural edges appear only between independently scrollable or resizable regions.
contracts.width_behavior: Columns share aligned roles; narrow layouts move secondary facts below without clipping actions or focus.
contracts.pointer_touch: Rows and their explicit actions have separate named targets; selection never hides the primary action.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Available data stays visible during stale, partial, offline, and recoverable error states.

accessibility.role: list, table, grid, or named region according to the interaction
accessibility.name: Visible app and section heading
accessibility.focus: Only interactive rows enter the tab order

keyboard.entry: Tab to filters or first action
keys: Arrow keys only for documented composites
keyboard.restore: Selected row or invoking action after detail closes

content_constraints: Use real records and honest empty copy
Keep timestamps and amounts aligned as data

contracts.user_job: Understand current operation state and recover without losing work.
contracts.boundary_rationale: Feedback is inline and unboxed unless containment is necessary to keep an overlay readable.
contracts.width_behavior: Wraps in place and leaves its recovery action on a complete 44px target.
contracts.pointer_touch: Recovery actions activate once; dismiss never masks a persistent failure state.
contracts.disabled_loading_repeat: Progress never claims completion and has a reduced-motion equivalent.

accessibility.role: status or alert according to urgency
accessibility.name: State copy
accessibility.focus: Feedback itself is not focusable unless it contains an action

keyboard.restore: Invoking control when transient overlay closes

content_constraints: Name the cause and next step
Do not use color or a dot alone
